dedupe_keys.name: roszheldor open data russian federal railway transport agency

description: The Federal Agency for Railway Transport of Russia (Roszheldor) publishes open data sets from the information resources it keeps. Transport-relevant sets include lists of railway stations in Russia and in CIS countries (updated March 2026), tariff distances between stations and between transit points, restrictions on infrastructure capacity during track repair and construction works, notices banning or permitting freight loading under Russian Railways (RZD) telegrams (updated September 2026), and the register of transport infrastructure objects and vehicles of railway transport, with sections for infrastructure objects, metro infrastructure, passenger cars and freight wagons (updated September 2026). Other sets cover the agency's administration, security registers and accredited bodies. Coverage is national. The terms follow the 2016 standard conditions for public open data: free use for lawful purposes with a link to the source. Access: files on the agency site; some sets, including the infrastructure register, need login through the Gosuslugi (ESIA) portal. Caveats: pages are in Russian, and the register sets are closed to users without a Russian public services account. The data support rail network flow models, capacity planning with work-related restrictions and disruption analysis. They complement the Rosaviatsia open data and the Ministry of Transport open data catalogued here.
